pushd $SRC/json-c-json-c-0.17-20230812
  mkdir build
  cd build
  cmake -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF ..
  make -j$(nproc)
  make install
popd

bash -x ./ndpi/tests/ossfuzz.sh
pushd $SRC/ndpi/tests/unit
    make unit
popd
project_yaml:
homepage: "https://www.ntop.org/products/deep-packet-inspection/ndpi/"
language: c++
primary_contact: "luca.deri@gmail.com"
auto_ccs :
  - "p.antoine@catenacyber.fr"
  - "nardi.ivan@gmail.com"
sanitizers:
  - address
  - undefined
  - memory
main_repo: 'https://github.com/ntop/nDPI.git'
base_os_version: ubuntu-24-04

#As a general rule, we want coverage for all the third party code that we have
#in our repository. Two exceptions:
# 1) Coverage report doesn't analyze custom mutator code
#    (see https://github.com/google/oss-fuzz/issues/12143) --> exclude it
# 2) croaring is HUGE (its size is comparable to the entire nDPI codebase!)
#    and we are using only a tiny part of it.
#    Note that we do fuzz that part (also) via the specific fuzz_ds_bitmap fuzzer
coverage_extra_args: >
  -ignore-filename-regex=src/lib/third_party/src/fuzz/.*
  -ignore-filename-regex=src/lib/third_party/src/roaring.c
  -ignore-filename-regex=src/lib/third_party/include/roaring.h

FROM gcr.io/oss-fuzz-base/base-builder:ubuntu-24-04
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y make autoconf automake autogen pkg-config libtool flex bison cmake libnuma-dev libpcre2-dev libjson-c-dev
RUN git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/ntop/nDPI.git ndpi
ADD https://www.tcpdump.org/release/libpcap-1.9.1.tar.gz libpcap-1.9.1.tar.gz
ADD https://github.com/json-c/json-c/archive/refs/tags/json-c-0.17-20230812.tar.gz json-c-0.17-20230812.tar.gz
RUN tar -xvzf json-c-0.17-20230812.tar.gz
COPY build.sh run_tests.sh $SRC/
WORKDIR $SRC
